Questions

Answers, before you ask.

Do you work with individual agents or teams?

Both. LocalLift works for a single agent, a team or a brokerage with many profiles.

Can you help me show up in specific neighborhoods?

Yes. Map Reach measures your Google Maps rank across the neighborhoods you choose, and your posts and content are written for those same areas.

Do I need to write the posts myself?

No. We write and publish daily Google posts on your listings, sales and market notes. You can review them whenever you like.

How do you handle client reviews?

Review Desk answers every review in your voice, so each reply adds to your reputation instead of sitting unanswered.
